_source: TPC-H 3.0.1 section 2.4: the qgen substitution parameters of each template, as data for declarative_spec.templates.generate_bindings. A SQL expression of a substitution parameter (DATE + INTERVAL, DISCOUNT +- 0.01, '1998-12-01' - DELTA days) is a second parameter drawn as a shift of the first, because a template parameter may only stand directly against a column.
_q12: TPC-H 3.0.1 clause 2.4.12.3: SHIPMODE1 is randomly selected within the list of values defined for Modes in clause 4.2.2.13 (REG AIR, AIR, RAIL, SHIP, TRUCK, MAIL, FOB); SHIPMODE2 likewise and must be different from SHIPMODE1 (distinct_from); DATE is the first of January of a randomly selected year within [1993 .. 1997], and the query's upper bound DATE + INTERVAL '1' YEAR is rcpt_hi, a one-year shift of rcpt_lo. Validation values (clause 2.4.12.4): MAIL, SHIP, 1994-01-01.
